reveal.terms: "Indexing" means writing a name in filing order: surname first, then given name, then middle initial. A title such as Dr. is the last unit.
reveal.shortcut: Rewrite each surname as one block: drop spaces and hyphens, keep the prefix (Dela Cruz = DELACRUZ). Then compare letter by letter (ARMA Rule 1). Order: Teresita B. Jose → JOSE, Teresita; Atty. Danilo G. Juan → JUAN, Danilo; Benito L. Lim → LIM, Benito; Mario P. Navarro → NAVARRO, Mario.

why_wrong.o1: "Teresita B. Jose" sorts by the given name. Personal names file by surname first.
why_wrong.o2: "Atty. Danilo G. Juan" sorts by the title (Dr., Atty., Engr.). A title is only the last unit.
why_wrong.o3: "Benito L. Lim" files as LIM, which comes before NAVARRO.
